newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-April EBR 319 mln punts - Finance Dept.
newsitem.headline: Irish end-April EBR 319 mln punts - Finance Dept.

text.p: Ireland's end-April Exchequer Borrowing Requirement (EBR) totalled 319 million pounds, the Department of Finance said on Friday. Economists forecasts ranged from just under 400 million to in excess of 600 million punts.

Total tax receipts to end-April came to 4.162 billion Irish pounds versus 3.501 billion a year earlier. Miscellaneous revenue totalled 61.665 million punts versus 71.004 million last year, while other receipts came to 52.933 million versus 14.232 million. On the spending side, central fund issues came to 1.114 billion versus 1.107 billion, and supply services issues came to 3.656 billion versus 3.584 billion last year. Other issues totalled 2.177 million. -- Dublin Newsroom + 353 1 676 9775
